title: Big-O & Efficiency
description: Count the steps your code takes. Sort snippets into O(1), O(log n), O(n) and O(n²), then speed up a scouting app's duplicate-team check from millions of steps to a few thousand with a HashSet.

checkpoints.title: Classify the snippets
checkpoints.description: Every snippet in Answers.java is marked CONSTANT, LOG_N, LINEAR or N_SQUARED correctly.

checkpoints.title: One step, one pass
checkpoints.description: ScoutStats.latest returns the last score in one look (O(1)) and ScoutStats.best returns the highest in one pass (O(n)); both return 0 for an empty list.

checkpoints.title: A fast duplicate check
checkpoints.description: Duplicates.hasDuplicate gives the same answer as hasDuplicateSlow, but looks at each team only once by using a HashSet (O(n) instead of O(n²)).

checkpoints.title: Teams at both events
checkpoints.description: EventOverlap.teamsInBoth counts the different teams that appear in both lists, in O(n + m) steps.
